subject: POC environment: ownership & next steps for network / SSO / KMS
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@stellarsight.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft attached (POC env dependencies)

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and the attached Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft focused on the POC environment milestones we discussed. Please review and confirm owners/timelines below.

High-level POC timeline
- Target POC start: 2026-07-01
- Target POC finish: 2026-07-22 (3-week validation window)

POC milestone: environment & network dependencies (what we need to unblock start)
- VPC peering: customer-owned (StellarSight network team) — required for private connectivity to dedicated test cluster
- IP allowlist: customer to add Redwood egress IPs to allowlist for control-plane and metrics endpoints
- SSO / SAML: exchange IdP metadata + Redwood to provide SP metadata; initial SAML test accounts required
- Secrets / KMS: StellarSight to provision role/policy or shared KMS key; Redwood can support AWS KMS integration patterns and provide guidance

Responsibilities (draft)
- StellarSight: configure VPC peering, update allowlists, provide IdP (Okta) metadata, grant test IAM role access to KMS key
- Redwood: share SAML SP metadata & ACS URL, provide KMS integration instructions and an IAM role template, schedule a network handoff call with your cloud ops

Blocked items we called out on the call
1) Confirmation that StellarSight will manage the VPC peering (who owns the ticket/POC owner?)
2) Okta metadata availability date
3) Expected contact for IP allowlist changes (alias for ops team)

Attachments:
- redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft — milestone table + responsibilities)

Ask / next steps
- Can you confirm owners for the four items above and provide the IdP metadata by EOD 2026-06-20?
- If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min network handoff with our infra engineer (Marissa) — propose Tue 6/16 or Thu 6/17.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP based on your replies and send an updated milestone table.

—
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@stellarsight.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: IT Ops <itops@stellarsight.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft attached (POC env dependencies)

Aditya — thanks for the notes and the MAP draft. Quick answers from my side:

- VPC peering: confirmed. Our network team will own the peering request. Point of contact: IT Ops (itops@stellarsight.com). We’ll open a ticket by 2026-06-17.
- IP allowlist: IT Ops will add Redwood egress IPs to our allowlist. Please send the full list of /32s and any FQDN endpoints we should allow.
- SSO / SAML: we use Okta. I can export the IdP metadata by 2026-06-20 and share it with you. We will need the SP metadata from Redwood (ACS URL, EntityID).
- Secrets / KMS: we use AWS KMS (customer-managed CMKs). We prefer not to share key material; instead, we can create a key and grant Redwood an IAM role with decrypt/encrypt permissions. Can you confirm the minimal IAM policy you need?

I attached our simple network topology for context.

Network handoff call: Tue 6/16 is tight for us (short notice), Thu 6/17 works better — if Marissa can do Thu 6/17 10:30am PT that would be ideal.

Thanks — I’ll await the SP metadata and the IP list.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Li
Head of Platform Engineering, StellarSight
samantha.li@stellarsight.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments:
- network_topology.png (attachment/png)

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: MAP update: owners, deadlines, and action items (POC env)

Samantha — thanks for the quick replies and the topology diagram. I’ve updated the MAP milestone for the POC environment below with owners and firm dates to keep momentum. Please review and confirm or propose changes. I’ve attached the updated MAP PDF plus a SAML SP template and KMS/IAM instructions from our infra team.

Updated milestone: POC environment (critical path to POC start)
- VPC peering
  - Owner: StellarSight network team (IT Ops)
  - Action: open peering ticket and share VPC IDs and routing table contact
  - Due: 2026-06-24
- IP allowlist
  - Owner: StellarSight IT Ops
  - Action: add Redwood egress IP list to allowlist for control-plane endpoints; confirm once applied
  - Due: 2026-06-24
- SSO / SAML exchange
  - Owner: Joint (StellarSight IdP + Redwood SSO team)
  - Action (StellarSight): provide Okta IdP metadata (XML) — due 2026-06-20
  - Action (Redwood): provide SP metadata (ACS URL, EntityID) and a SAML test account procedure — due 2026-06-19 (Redwood to send SAML template)
- Secrets / KMS integration
  - Owner: Joint (StellarSight infra + Redwood infra)
  - Action (StellarSight): create CMK or grant an IAM role with kms:Encrypt/Decrypt permissions to the test key
  - Action (Redwood): provide IAM policy template and instructions for cross-account access — due 2026-06-19

POC schedule (confirmed by Redwood)
- POC environment validation window: 2026-07-01 through 2026-07-22
- POC kickoff: once all critical-path items are marked complete (target 2026-07-01)

Attachments included:
- redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf (updated)
- redwood_saml_template.xml (SAML SP metadata + sample config)
- redwood_kms_iam_instructions.pdf (IAM policy + cross-account instructions)

Immediate next steps (this week)
1) Samantha / IT Ops: open VPC peering ticket and add Redwood egress IPs — due 6/24. Please paste the ticket link in reply.
2) Samantha: share Okta IdP metadata by 6/20.
3) Redwood (Marissa): schedule network handoff call Thu 6/17 at 10:30am PT with IT Ops — Marissa will send the calendar invite.
4) Redwood (Karthik): share IAM policy template and KMS guidance by 6/19.

If this looks good I’ll mark the MAP milestone as final for the POC network work and flag any outstanding risks (e.g., if peering ticket slips we may need to run in hosted mode with limited data).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890 (deal RDW-7891)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
